name: LitigationDeadlineDocketer
tagline: Rules-based litigation deadline docketing with cascading recalculation – in one Power Apps control.
description: Calculate every deadline a trigger event starts – complaint served, motion served, trial date set, judgment entered – with calendar or court-day counting, service-method extensions, court holidays and roll-forward, then docket, confirm, track and recalculate them across dashboard, docket, calendar and matter timelines. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, starts with fictional demo data and connects to your deadline table in a few clicks.
features: Calendar and court-day counting, before/after trigger
Mail, courier and electronic service extensions
Court holidays and weekends with roll-forward
Conflict detection: overload, non-court day, unassigned, sequence
Custom rules in a plain-text format – no JSON
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
